metadata.purpose: Track current-public-source freshness without converting an unverified publication gap into a zero, overwriting historical provenance with a replacement URL, or asserting that no newer source exists merely because a registered source still reproduces.

status_semantics.verified_current: An authoritative public source covering the latest currently applicable period was verified and is represented in production.
status_semantics.verified_new_source: A newer authoritative public source was verified but is not yet represented in production.
status_semantics.not_yet_verified: Targeted research did not verify the targeted newer source. This is not proof that the source does not exist, is late, or will not be published.
status_semantics.current_source_research: The domain source discovery itself was refreshed on the research date; publication/approval timing still governs record availability.

write_refresh.note: The established write-capable weekly refresh remains limited to compensation and budget ingestion.

read_only_domain_monitor.failure_isolation: Seven independent jobs; no domain depends on another domain succeeding.
read_only_domain_monitor.note: The monitor reproduces registered evidence and/or discovers current public records into ephemeral workflow artifacts. It has no repository write permission and does not auto-publish new reporting periods, Council decisions, replacement document identities, or other freshness candidates.
